places.name: Zamindar's Clubhouse
places.why: Dressed-up South End Indian dining room styled after old-world estate clubs, from a chef whose New York restaurant holds a Bib Gourmand; go for the chaat and seafood curries and pair them with spice-forward cocktails. Dinner only, closed Mondays.
places.open_check: open (Scoop Charlotte 2026-11-21 lists current hours; official site live with menu and Tue-Sun dinner hours)

places.name: Guard & Grace
places.address: 111 E Carson Blvd Ste 100, Charlotte, NC 28203
places.why: Denver's high-rise steakhouse opened its Charlotte outpost this fall on the 10th floor of a new South End tower; the filet tasting flight is the signature order and the skyline views suit a special occasion.
places.open_check: open (opened Oct 2026; Scoop Charlotte 2026-11-21 recommends its filet flight and lists Mon-Sat dinner hours)

places.name: Deepwell
places.why: The Kindred team's steakhouse in a restored downtown Mooresville building, with in-house dry-aged beef and chef Craig Deihl running the kitchen; a handsome room for a splurge if you're up near the lake.
places.open_check: open (opened Sept 2026; Scoop Charlotte 2026-11-21 lists current Wed-Sun dinner hours)

places.name: Emmy Lou's
places.address: 2400 Park Rd Ste H, Charlotte, NC 28203
places.why: Small wine bar and bottle shop from the Customshop owners with communal tables, a seven-seat bar and a patio; seasonal snacks and light plates make it an easy, walk-in date. No reservations.
places.open_check: open (Scoop Charlotte 2026-11-21 lists daily hours; open since Dec 2025)

places.name: Dressler's
places.why: Long-running Midtown steakhouse that still earns praise for warm, regulars-style service, solid steaks and starters like pimento cheese and shrimp and grits, plus a strong cocktail bar. Valet helps with the tricky Metropolitan parking.
places.open_check: open (Unpretentious Palate review updated 2026-11-17 describes it as operating; OpenTable reservations listed)

places.name: PostScript
places.cuisine: French, Italian and American comfort food
places.why: Husband-and-wife neighborhood spot in the old Letty's space doing seasonal European-leaning comfort dishes like chicken scarpariello and mushroom stroganoff cavatelli; warm, low-key room for a relaxed date.
places.open_check: open (named among 2026 openings to try by Scoop Charlotte 2026-11-21; official site says dinner Tue-Sat)

places.name: Uchi / Uchibā
places.why: Austin's celebrated modern-Japanese group opened its first Carolinas location this spring, with creative sushi and hot plates at Uchi and a more casual izakaya-style bar upstairs at Uchibā; readers voted it the top opening of the year. Save room for the fried milk dessert.
places.open_check: open (opened April 2026; Scoop Charlotte 2026-11-21 lists current hours for both Uchi and Uchibā)

places.name: Sharigato
places.why: Counter-style hand-roll bar from chef Shari Robins where rolls come in sets or a la carte, alongside sashimi and snacks like truffle edamame; a quick, fun sushi stop in Optimist Park.
places.open_check: open (opened May 2026; named among 2026 openings to try by Scoop Charlotte 2026-11-21)

places.name: Mochi's Deli
places.why: No-frills Dilworth deli piling up big, made-to-order New York-style sandwiches at fair prices; lines can be long, so call ahead. The chicken Italiano is the one to get.
places.open_check: open (Scoop Charlotte 2026-11-21 lists current Wed-Sun hours; Axios covered crowds there Sept 2026)

places.name: Olivelli Deli
places.cuisine: Walk-up deli sandwiches and soft serve
places.why: Tiny walk-up window in NoDa from the Tonidandel-Brown group (Haberdish, Supperland) selling fresh sandwiches and soft serve; order at the window or online.
places.open_check: open (opened July 2026; named among 2026 openings to try by Scoop Charlotte 2026-11-21)

places.name: Grey's Diner + Community Kitchen
places.why: Chef Sam Diminich (Restaurant Constance) revived the old Mattie's Diner car on The Plaza with a chef-driven take on diner breakfasts, lunches and dinners; a good bet for a relaxed weekend breakfast.
places.open_check: open (opened April 2026; named among 2026 openings to try by Scoop Charlotte 2026-11-21)

places.name: The Story of Mi Cariño
places.address: 1440 S Tryon St Ste 100, Charlotte, NC 28203
places.cuisine: Mexican and Latin American gastro cantina, mezcaleria
places.why: South End cantina and mezcal bar from the Vinyl team that opened in January 2026 and earned a Bib Gourmand on its first try; the crispy fish tacos and rajas con crema are standout orders.
places.open_check: open (Scoop Charlotte 2026-11-21 lists current nightly hours)

places.name: DŌZO
places.address: 1419 East Blvd Ste A, Charlotte, NC 28203
places.why: The former City Kitch counter grew into a full Dilworth restaurant with a patio in early 2026, still serving big, shareable Japanese comfort food like tonkatsu, crispy potatoes and smoked salmon dip.
places.open_check: open (moved from City Kitch to 1419 East Blvd in Jan 2026; Scoop Charlotte 2026-11-21 lists Tue-Sat lunch and dinner hours)

places.name: Hatoya
places.why: Family-run Japanese grocery in Pineville since 1992 that locals point to for sashimi-grade fish and uni, plus pantry staples and snacks; best for takeaway rather than a sit-down meal.
places.open_check: open (official site hatoyamart.com live on 2026-11-23 showing daily 10am-6pm hours; consistent listings at 605 N Polk St, Pineville; no closure reports found)
